description: Known, explained differences between the inventory row count (stored in the .qvw at the author's last reload) and the repo's source data. 'apps' is a regex on the manifest name.

exceptions.reason: Repo Dimension Tables.mdb (and Origin Airports.qvd) hold 6,209 airports; the .qvw was reloaded from an older copy of the .mdb with 2,104. The repo table is a superset: all 2,124 origin airport IDs used by Flight Data are present, so measures are unaffected; only unassociated airport rows differ.

Repo Dimension Tables.mdb (and Destination Airports.qvd) hold 6,209 airports; the .qvw was reloaded from an older copy of the .mdb with 2,169. The repo table is a superset: all 2,185 destination airport IDs used by Flight Data are present, so measures are unaffected; only unassociated airport rows differ.
